criteria.text: The slash-command popover ListView must be scrollable: after drag-scrolling the list upward, commands that were initially below the visible area (e.g. /cmd27 out of 30 commands) must become visible.
criteria.test_id: issue #643 — slash-command popover list is scrollable scrolling reveals commands that were below the visible area
criteria.notes: Root causes: (1) Stack(clipBehavior:Clip.none)+Positioned(bottom:0) rendered the command list OUTSIDE the Stack's hit-test bounds — Flutter paints overflowing children (Clip.none) but does not route pointer/scroll events to them. (2) ListView.builder(shrinkWrap:true) disabled scroll physics by sizing the ListView to its full content height, making the Container(maxHeight:240) merely a visual clip with no scroll viewport. Fix: replaced Stack+Positioned with Column(mainAxisSize:min) so the list is within a properly hit-testable bounds, and removed shrinkWrap:true so the ListView uses the Container's 240px as its scroll viewport.

criteria.text: The last command must be reachable via Scrollable.ensureVisible when more than ~8 commands are in the list.
criteria.test_id: issue #643 — slash-command popover list is scrollable last command is reachable via Scrollable.ensureVisible after opening popover

not_tested: Keyboard arrow-key navigation scrolling when the highlighted index is below the visible fold (requires integration with the real app's focus tree).
